Sunday shift at the café. Eight hours. Extra pay by law? Guess: yes or no.

text: In Germany, no. You only get one if your contract or a pay agreement says so.
But here's the twist. If your boss pays one, up to fifty percent extra is tax-free on Sundays.

Say you earn minimum wage, thirteen euros ninety. Eight hours is one hundred eleven euros twenty.

text: A fifty percent bonus adds fifty-five euros sixty. No tax and no social contributions taken off.

Public holidays? Up to a hundred twenty-five percent tax-free. The first of May, a hundred fifty.

text: Would you work Sundays for fifty percent more? Yes or no.
